Explanation: The ground truth answer states that the current youngest US House Representative is 14 years younger than Davy Crockett was when he was elected. The predicted answer claims that the difference is "approximately 13 years younger." Although the predicted answer provides close information and reasoning, it does not accurately match the ground truth value of 14 years—the vital fact (the age difference) is misstated. The substance required by the ground truth (the number 14) is not sufficiently present.

Decision: FALSE
